subject: Food Science
title: Detox Diets Are Fiction
description: One-minute skill: Detox Diets Are Fiction.

hook.text: The $60 billion detox industry sells juice cleanses and supplements. Your liver and kidneys already detox for free—24 hours a day.

buildup.text: The liver processes toxins through two enzyme phases, converting them to water-soluble compounds excreted by the kidneys.

discovery.text: No detox product has ever been proven to remove specific toxins from the body faster than normal organ function.

twist.text: Juice cleanses can harm—they spike blood sugar, deprive the body of protein and fat, and can cause electrolyte imbalances.

climax.text: The best 'detox' is simply reducing intake of processed food, alcohol, and added sugar—supporting organs you already have.

punchline.text: Your liver detoxes you for free. Juice cleanses just empty your wallet.

quiz.question: Have detox products been scientifically proven to remove toxins?
options: No—no detox product has proven to work faster than normal liver and kidney function
Only herbal teas have been proven
